role: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst - Finance & Accounting
responsibilities: Own the execution of Finance and Accounting's BI tool portfolio, currently including Capital Management and In-Servicing, Labor Reporting, and Production web application with expansion to new tools as reporting or controls needs are identified
Partner with ET to determine what logic belongs in business intelligence vs. source systems and lead automation of inventory reconciliations and costing sheet rate monitoring
Lead the design of automated logic, using transaction detail and accounting guidance to flag and correct transactions, and drive upstream error-prevention to reduce reliance on manual corrections
Identify gaps in existing Finance and Accounting reporting and lead the design and build of new BI tools to address them
Set priorities for the BI roadmap with Finance, Accounting, and ET leadership, and represent Finance and Accounting BI needs in enterprise data governance discussions
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other BI analysts and supporting their development

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: drive upstream error-prevention to reduce reliance on manual corrections
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Controls gaps, reconciliations, transaction correction and data governance dominate, with no speed language.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The tools feed cost accounting, inventory reconciliations and accounting controls, so errors reach financial reporting.
evidence.data_team_maturity: with the expectation that this portfolio will grow
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing suite of named BI tools and other BI analysts to mentor, with a portfolio expected to grow, places the function at mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: lead automation of inventory reconciliations and costing sheet rate monitoring
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the actual tools (Capital Management and In-Servicing, Labor Reporting) and the specific accounting processes to automate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Every bullet serves Finance and Accounting: capital, labor, inventory costing and reconciliations.
evidence.autonomy_level: own the strategy and roadmap for the suite of BI tools
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The JD calls it "a senior, high-autonomy role" that sets the BI roadmap and leads build-vs-integrate decisions.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only in the team name and as a preferred "applying AI/ML to automate error detection", not as a coding-tool or AI-data-infrastructure expectation.
evidence.testing_framing: using transaction detail and accounting guidance to flag and correct transactions
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The candidate owns automated error detection and upstream error prevention, a data quality practice framed as a responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: to close reporting or controls gaps as the business scales
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The role summary is framed around accounting controls gaps and error prevention, a compliance-style fear.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: set direction for how existing tools evolve
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role evolves an existing tool suite and also leads the design and build of new BI tools.
